preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L1 <= R1 <= len(S) for L1, R1, _, _ in queries) and all(1 <= L2 <= R2 <= len(S) for _, _, L2, R2 in queries)
preconditions.description: Every query's L1, R1, L2, R2 are valid 1-based indices within the string S, inclusive, and L1 ≤ R1, L2 ≤ R2.

preconditions.expression: S.islower() and all(c.islower() for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S consists only of lowercase letters.

preconditions.expression: Q == int(Q_line) and Q >= 1 and Q <= 10**5
preconditions.description: Q is a positive integer (1 ≤ Q ≤ 10^5) representing the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line == 'Yes' if S[L1-1:R1] == S[L2-1:R2] else stdout_line == 'No' for (L1, R1, L2, R2), stdout_line in zip(queries, output_lines))
postconditions.description: For each query (L1, R1, L2, R2), the output line is 'Yes' if and only if the substring S[L1..R1] (0-based: S[L1-1:R1]) is exactly equal to the substring S[L2..R2] (0-based: S[L2-1:R2]).
